governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust. No row here is an active capability; each must pass the seeder's gap/lift screen, then human/eval gates, before any promotion. Source names/URLs are from n8n's built-in app-nodes documentation (docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/) verified to enumerate ~270 native integration nodes; each node URL follows the stable n8n-nodes-base.<node> pattern and individual pages were spot-confirmed to exist via WebFetch (Webflow, Pipedrive, Coda, Xero) though operation tables were truncated by the markdown converter. n8n is licensed under the Sustainable Use License (fair-code, NOT an OSI-approved license) — carried in license/verify_note for every n8n-sourced row. Make.com (3,000+ apps) and Zapier (9,000+ apps) connector existence was corroborated via search. serves_truth=false for everything downstream; operation surfaces are described from standard public API knowledge of each SaaS and must be re-verified against the live node before any reliance.
